metadata.description: Brief six- and ten-item screens for non-specific psychological distress.
metadata.intended_use: Population surveys and mental-health screening for general psychological distress.
metadata.name_origin: K6 and K10 refer to the six- and ten-item Kessler distress forms.
metadata.development_history: Developed for efficient monitoring of population prevalence and trends in psychological distress.
metadata.measurement_rationale: Short symptom-frequency questions identify broad distress without assigning a specific disorder.
metadata.interpretation_notes: Screening thresholds are context-specific and do not establish a diagnosis; use the selected form's scoring guidance.

versions.source_citation: Kessler et al. (2002). Short screening scales to monitor population prevalences and trends in non-specific psychological distress.

source_documents.title: K6/K10 official scale information
source_documents.license_name: Metadata reference; exact German edition and reuse terms require source review
source_documents.permission_basis: Only discovery and bibliographic metadata is stored. Item wording and forms are excluded until the exact German version and reuse terms are verified.
